### SECTION: Standard of Living Computation

# EU5 1.3 demand path: calibrated demand_add remains in goods, while
# monthly location local_pop_demand is sized as liquid funds / base spending.

gls_compute_savings_pressure = {
	# root = country. Unified pressure: (total savings / total target - 1) * 0.25, capped at +50%.
	set_variable = { name = gls_country_wealth_anchor_cached value = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax min = 0 } }

	set_variable = { name = gls_nobles_gold value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
		set_variable = { name = gls_nobles_gold value = "estate(estate_type:nobles_estate).estate_gold" }
	}
	set_variable = { name = gls_nobles_target value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
		set_variable = { name = gls_nobles_target value = { value = 200 add = { value = var:gls_country_wealth_anchor_cached multiply = 8 } min = 80 } }
	}

	set_variable = { name = gls_clergy_gold value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate }
		set_variable = { name = gls_clergy_gold value = "estate(estate_type:clergy_estate).estate_gold" }
	}
	set_variable = { name = gls_clergy_target value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate }
		set_variable = { name = gls_clergy_target value = { value = 100 add = { value = var:gls_country_wealth_anchor_cached multiply = 3 } min = 60 } }
	}

	set_variable = { name = gls_burghers_gold value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate }
		set_variable = { name = gls_burghers_gold value = "estate(estate_type:burghers_estate).estate_gold" }
	}
	set_variable = { name = gls_burghers_target value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate }
		set_variable = { name = gls_burghers_target value = { value = 100 add = { value = var:gls_country_wealth_anchor_cached multiply = 3 } min = 60 } }
	}

	set_variable = { name = gls_commoner_gold value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate }
		set_variable = { name = gls_commoner_gold value = "estate(estate_type:peasants_estate).estate_gold" }
	}
	set_variable = { name = gls_commoner_target value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate }
		set_variable = { name = gls_commoner_target value = { value = 0 add = { value = var:gls_country_wealth_anchor_cached multiply = 2 } min = 45 } }
	}

	set_variable = { name = gls_tribesmen_gold value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:tribes_estate }
		set_variable = { name = gls_tribesmen_gold value = "estate(estate_type:tribes_estate).estate_gold" }
	}
	set_variable = { name = gls_tribesmen_target value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:tribes_estate }
		set_variable = { name = gls_tribesmen_target value = { value = 0 add = { value = var:gls_country_wealth_anchor_cached multiply = 1 } min = 35 } }
	}

	set_variable = { name = gls_total_savings value = { add = var:gls_nobles_gold add = var:gls_clergy_gold add = var:gls_burghers_gold add = var:gls_commoner_gold add = var:gls_tribesmen_gold } }
	set_variable = { name = gls_total_savings_target value = { add = var:gls_nobles_target add = var:gls_clergy_target add = var:gls_burghers_target add = var:gls_commoner_target add = var:gls_tribesmen_target } }
	set_variable = { name = gls_savings_pressure_adjustment value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:gls_total_savings_target > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gls_savings_pressure_adjustment value = { value = var:gls_total_savings divide = var:gls_total_savings_target subtract = 1 multiply = 0.25 max = 0.5 } }
	}
}

sol_count_location_estate_buildings = {
	# root = location. Cached yearly; each estate building has 1 gold maintenance.
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_buildings_nobles value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_buildings_clergy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_buildings_burghers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_buildings_commoners value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_buildings_tribesmen value = 0 }

	every_buildings_in_location = {
		if = {
			limit = { estate_type ?= estate_type:nobles_estate }
			location = { change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_buildings_nobles add = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { estate_type ?= estate_type:clergy_estate }
			location = { change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_buildings_clergy add = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { estate_type ?= estate_type:burghers_estate }
			location = { change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_buildings_burghers add = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { estate_type ?= estate_type:peasants_estate }
			location = { change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_buildings_commoners add = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { estate_type ?= estate_type:tribes_estate }
			location = { change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_buildings_tribesmen add = 1 } }
		}
	}

	set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_nobles value = var:sol_location_estate_buildings_nobles }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_clergy value = var:sol_location_estate_buildings_clergy }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_burghers value = var:sol_location_estate_buildings_burghers }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_commoners value = var:sol_location_estate_buildings_commoners }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen value = var:sol_location_estate_buildings_tribesmen }
}

sol_update_estate_building_maintenance = {
	# root = country. Yearly cache on each owned land location.
	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes }
			sol_count_location_estate_buildings = yes
		}
	}
}

					value = sol_unit_consumption_burghers_wheat
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wheat
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_laborers_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_laborers_wheat
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wheat
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_peasants_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_peasants_wheat
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wheat
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_soldiers_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_soldiers_wheat
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wheat
				}
			}
		}

		set_local_variable = {
			name = sol_market_effective_price_wild_game
			value = {
				value = "market_price(goods:wild_game)"
				max = "default_price(goods:wild_game)"
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_consumes_wild_game_count value = "goods_supply_in_market(goods:wild_game)" }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_consumes_wild_game key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_consumes_wild_game key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_consumes_wild_game_count }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sol_market_consumes_wild_game_count > 0 }
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_nobles_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_nobles_wild_game
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wild_game
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_clergy_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_clergy_wild_game
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wild_game
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_burghers_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_burghers_wild_game
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wild_game
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_laborers_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_laborers_wild_game
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wild_game
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_peasants_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_peasants_wild_game
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wild_game
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_soldiers_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_soldiers_wild_game
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wild_game
				}
			}
		}

		set_local_variable = {
			name = sol_market_effective_price_wine
			value = {
				value = "market_price(goods:wine)"
				max = "default_price(goods:wine)"
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_market_consumes_wine_count value = "goods_supply_in_market(goods:wine)" }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_consumes_wine key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_consumes_wine key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_consumes_wine_count }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sol_market_consumes_wine_count > 0 }
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_nobles_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_nobles_wine
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wine
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_clergy_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_clergy_wine
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wine
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_burghers_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_burghers_wine
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wine
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_laborers_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_laborers_wine
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wine
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_peasants_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_peasants_wine
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wine
				}
			}
			change_local_variable = {
				name = sol_market_soldiers_unit_spending
				add = {
					value = sol_unit_consumption_soldiers_wine
					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wine
				}
			}
		}

		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_nobles key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_nobles key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_nobles_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_clergy key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_clergy key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_clergy_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_burghers key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_burghers key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_burghers_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_laborers key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_laborers key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_laborers_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_peasants key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_peasants key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_peasants_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_soldiers key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_soldiers key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_soldiers_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_tribesmen key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_tribesmen key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_tribesmen_unit_spending }

		# Local variables persist beyond this recurring market pass; clear all scratch values.
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_nobles_unit_spending
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_clergy_unit_spending
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_burghers_unit_spending
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_laborers_unit_spending
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_peasants_unit_spending
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_soldiers_unit_spending
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_tribesmen_unit_spending
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_amber
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_amber_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_beer
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_beer_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_beeswax
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_beeswax_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_books
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_books_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_chili
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_chili_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_cloth
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_cloth_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_cloves
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_cloves_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_coal
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_coal_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_cocoa
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_cocoa_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_coffee
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_coffee_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_elephants
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_elephants_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_fine_cloth
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_fine_cloth_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_firearms
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_firearms_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_fish
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_fish_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_fruit
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_fruit_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_fur
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_fur_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_furniture
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_furniture_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_gems
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_gems_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_glass
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_glass_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_goods_gold
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_goods_gold_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_horses
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_horses_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_incense
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_incense_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_ivory
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_ivory_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_jewelry
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_jewelry_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_lacquerware
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_lacquerware_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_leather
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_leather_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_legumes
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_legumes_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_liquor
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_liquor_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_livestock
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_livestock_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_lumber
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_lumber_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_maize
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_maize_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_marble
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_marble_count

		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_masonry_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_medicaments
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_medicaments_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_mercury

		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_paper_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_pearls
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_pearls_count

		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_pepper_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_porcelain
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_porcelain_count

		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_saffron
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_saffron_count

		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_salt_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_silver
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_silver_count

		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_sugar_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_tea
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_tea_count

		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_tobacco_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_tools
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_tools_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_weaponry
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_weaponry_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_wheat
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_wheat_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_wild_game
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_wild_game_count
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_effective_price_wine
		remove_local_variable = sol_market_consumes_wine_count
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_market_pop_demand_maps_initialized value = 1 }
}

sol_compute_location_pop_demand = {
	# root = location. Raw display coefficient = liquid funds / market-filtered base spending.
	market ?= { save_scope_as = sol_location_market }

	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_nobles value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sol_location_market
			has_global_variable_map = sol_market_unit_spending_nobles
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_nobles target = scope:sol_location_market }
		}
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_nobles value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_unit_spending_nobles|scope:sol_location_market)" }
	}

	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_clergy value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sol_location_market
			has_global_variable_map = sol_market_unit_spending_clergy
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_clergy target = scope:sol_location_market }
		}
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_clergy value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_unit_spending_clergy|scope:sol_location_market)" }
	}

	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_burghers value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sol_location_market
			has_global_variable_map = sol_market_unit_spending_burghers
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_burghers target = scope:sol_location_market }
		}
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_burghers value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_unit_spending_burghers|scope:sol_location_market)" }
	}

	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_laborers value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sol_location_market
			has_global_variable_map = sol_market_unit_spending_laborers
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_laborers target = scope:sol_location_market }
		}
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_laborers value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_unit_spending_laborers|scope:sol_location_market)" }
	}

	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_peasants value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sol_location_market
			has_global_variable_map = sol_market_unit_spending_peasants
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_peasants target = scope:sol_location_market }
		}
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_peasants value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_unit_spending_peasants|scope:sol_location_market)" }
	}

	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_soldiers value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sol_location_market
			has_global_variable_map = sol_market_unit_spending_soldiers
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_soldiers target = scope:sol_location_market }
		}
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_soldiers value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_unit_spending_soldiers|scope:sol_location_market)" }
	}

	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_tribesmen value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:sol_location_market
			has_global_variable_map = sol_market_unit_spending_tribesmen
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_tribesmen target = scope:sol_location_market }
		}
		set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_tribesmen value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_unit_spending_tribesmen|scope:sol_location_market)" }
	}

	set_variable = { name = sol_location_nobles_income value = { add = local_sol_nobles_income_display } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_clergy_income value = { add = local_sol_clergy_income_display } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_burghers_income value = { add = local_sol_burghers_income_display } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_commoners_income value = { add = local_sol_commoners_income_display } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_tribesmen_income value = { add = local_sol_tribesmen_income_display } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_nobles_net_income value = { value = var:sol_location_nobles_income subtract = local_sol_nobles_building_maintenance min = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_clergy_net_income value = { value = var:sol_location_clergy_income subtract = local_sol_clergy_building_maintenance min = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_burghers_net_income value = { value = var:sol_location_burghers_income subtract = local_sol_burghers_building_maintenance min = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_commoners_net_income value = { value = var:sol_location_commoners_income subtract = local_sol_commoners_building_maintenance min = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_tribesmen_net_income value = { value = var:sol_location_tribesmen_income subtract = local_sol_tribesmen_building_maintenance min = 0 } }
	set_variable = {
		name = sol_location_total_income
		value = {
			add = var:sol_location_nobles_net_income
			add = var:sol_location_clergy_net_income
			add = var:sol_location_burghers_net_income
			add = var:sol_location_commoners_net_income
			add = var:sol_location_tribesmen_net_income
			min = 0
		}
	}

	set_variable = { name = sol_location_nobles_base_spending value = { value = var:sol_unit_spending_nobles multiply = num_pop_type:nobles } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_clergy_base_spending value = { value = var:sol_unit_spending_clergy multiply = num_pop_type:clergy } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_burghers_base_spending value = { value = var:sol_unit_spending_burghers multiply = num_pop_type:burghers } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_laborers_base_spending value = { value = var:sol_unit_spending_laborers multiply = num_pop_type:laborers } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_peasants_base_spending value = { value = var:sol_unit_spending_peasants multiply = num_pop_type:peasants } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_soldiers_base_spending value = { value = var:sol_unit_spending_soldiers multiply = num_pop_type:soldiers } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_tribesmen_base_spending value = { value = var:sol_unit_spending_tribesmen multiply = num_pop_type:tribesmen } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_commoners_base_spending value = 0 }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_commoners_base_spending add = var:sol_location_laborers_base_spending }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_commoners_base_spending add = var:sol_location_peasants_base_spending }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_commoners_base_spending add = var:sol_location_soldiers_base_spending }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_lower_base_spending value = 0 }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_lower_base_spending add = var:sol_location_commoners_base_spending }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_lower_base_spending add = var:sol_location_tribesmen_base_spending }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_base_total_spending value = 0 }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_base_total_spending add = var:sol_location_nobles_base_spending }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_base_total_spending add = var:sol_location_clergy_base_spending }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_base_total_spending add = var:sol_location_burghers_base_spending }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_base_total_spending add = var:sol_location_laborers_base_spending }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_base_total_spending add = var:sol_location_peasants_base_spending }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_base_total_spending add = var:sol_location_soldiers_base_spending }
	change_variable = { name = sol_location_base_total_spending add = var:sol_location_tribesmen_base_spending }

	set_variable = { name = sol_location_savings_pressure_adjustment value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = owner }
		if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = gls_savings_pressure_adjustment } } set_variable = { name = sol_location_savings_pressure_adjustment value = owner.var:gls_savings_pressure_adjustment } }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_liquid_funds_multiplier value = { value = 1 add = var:sol_location_savings_pressure_adjustment min = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_liquid_funds value = { value = var:sol_location_total_income multiply = var:sol_location_liquid_funds_multiplier } }
	set_variable = { name = gls_location_actual_per_capita_spending value = { value = var:sol_location_liquid_funds divide = local_sol_total_population min = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_nobles_liquid_funds value = { value = var:sol_location_nobles_net_income multiply = var:sol_location_liquid_funds_multiplier } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_clergy_liquid_funds value = { value = var:sol_location_clergy_net_income multiply = var:sol_location_liquid_funds_multiplier } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_burghers_liquid_funds value = { value = var:sol_location_burghers_net_income multiply = var:sol_location_liquid_funds_multiplier } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_commoners_liquid_funds value = { value = var:sol_location_commoners_net_income multiply = var:sol_location_liquid_funds_multiplier } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_tribesmen_liquid_funds value = { value = var:sol_location_tribesmen_net_income multiply = var:sol_location_liquid_funds_multiplier } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_raw_demand_scale value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_location_base_total_spending > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_raw_demand_scale value = { value = var:sol_location_liquid_funds divide = var:sol_location_base_total_spending min = 0 } }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_final_demand_scale value = var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_pop_demand_modifier_size value = { value = var:sol_location_final_demand_scale subtract = 1 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_anchor_score_nobles value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_anchor_score_clergy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_anchor_score_burghers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_anchor_score_commoners value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_anchor_score_tribesmen value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_location_base_total_spending > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_anchor_score_nobles value = { value = var:sol_location_nobles_base_spending multiply = var:sol_location_nobles_base_spending divide = var:sol_location_base_total_spending } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_anchor_score_clergy value = { value = var:sol_location_clergy_base_spending multiply = var:sol_location_clergy_base_spending divide = var:sol_location_base_total_spending } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_anchor_score_burghers value = { value = var:sol_location_burghers_base_spending multiply = var:sol_location_burghers_base_spending divide = var:sol_location_base_total_spending } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_anchor_score_commoners value = { value = var:sol_location_commoners_base_spending multiply = var:sol_location_commoners_base_spending divide = var:sol_location_base_total_spending } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_anchor_score_tribesmen value = { value = var:sol_location_tribesmen_base_spending multiply = var:sol_location_tribesmen_base_spending divide = var:sol_location_base_total_spending } }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_share_nobles value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_share_clergy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_share_burghers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_share_lower value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_location_base_total_spending > 0.00001 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_share_nobles value = { value = var:sol_location_nobles_base_spending divide = var:sol_location_base_total_spending min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_share_clergy value = { value = var:sol_location_clergy_base_spending divide = var:sol_location_base_total_spending min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_share_burghers value = { value = var:sol_location_burghers_base_spending divide = var:sol_location_base_total_spending min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_share_lower value = { value = var:sol_location_lower_base_spending divide = var:sol_location_base_total_spending min = 0 } }
	}
}

sol_location_demand_clip_class_score = {
	if = { limit = { var:$score$ > 3 } set_variable = { name = $score$ value = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { var:$score$ < -3 } set_variable = { name = $score$ value = -3 } }
}

sol_location_demand_consider_structural_class = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:$score$ > var:sol_location_demand_structural_best_score }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_structural_second_score value = var:sol_location_demand_structural_best_score }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_structural_best_score value = var:$score$ }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_structural_class value = $class$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:$score$ > var:sol_location_demand_structural_second_score }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_structural_second_score value = var:$score$ }
	}
}

sol_location_prepare_demand_class_scores = {
	# Scores measure relative over-representation against the country structure.
	# The country normalizers have a 0.02 floor and scores are capped to [-3, 3].
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_structural_class value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_structural_best_score value = -3.1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_structural_second_score value = -3.1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_confidence value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_score_nobles value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_score_clergy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_score_burghers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_score_lower value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_location_base_total_spending > 0.00001 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_score_nobles value = { value = var:sol_location_share_nobles subtract = owner.var:sol_country_share_nobles divide = owner.var:sol_country_class_normalizer_nobles } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_score_clergy value = { value = var:sol_location_share_clergy subtract = owner.var:sol_country_share_clergy divide = owner.var:sol_country_class_normalizer_clergy } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_score_burghers value = { value = var:sol_location_share_burghers subtract = owner.var:sol_country_share_burghers divide = owner.var:sol_country_class_normalizer_burghers } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_score_lower value = { value = var:sol_location_share_lower subtract = owner.var:sol_country_share_lower divide = owner.var:sol_country_class_normalizer_lower } }
		sol_location_demand_clip_class_score = { score = sol_location_demand_score_nobles }
		sol_location_demand_clip_class_score = { score = sol_location_demand_score_clergy }
		sol_location_demand_clip_class_score = { score = sol_location_demand_score_burghers }
		sol_location_demand_clip_class_score = { score = sol_location_demand_score_lower }
		sol_location_demand_consider_structural_class = { class = 1 score = sol_location_demand_score_nobles }
		sol_location_demand_consider_structural_class = { class = 2 score = sol_location_demand_score_clergy }
		sol_location_demand_consider_structural_class = { class = 3 score = sol_location_demand_score_burghers }
		sol_location_demand_consider_structural_class = { class = 4 score = sol_location_demand_score_lower }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_confidence value = { value = var:sol_location_demand_structural_best_score subtract = var:sol_location_demand_structural_second_score min = 0 } }
	}
}

sol_location_demand_consider_balanced_class = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_penalty_candidate value = { value = owner.var:sol_country_class_base_total_$class$ divide = owner.var:sol_country_class_target_base multiply = owner.var:sol_country_class_balance_weight } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_score_candidate value = { value = var:$score$ subtract = var:sol_location_demand_class_penalty_candidate } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_location_demand_class_score_candidate > var:sol_location_demand_class_score }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class value = $class$ }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_score value = var:sol_location_demand_class_score_candidate }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_selected_affinity value = var:$score$ }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_selected_penalty value = var:sol_location_demand_class_penalty_candidate }
	}
}

sol_location_assign_demand_class = {
	# High-confidence locations are processed first by the country driver.
	# Each candidate loses balance_weight * current_class_base / target_base.
	# Fixed basis order for exact ties: nobles, clergy, burghers, lower.
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_score value = -999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_score_candidate value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_penalty_candidate value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_selected_affinity value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_location_demand_class_selected_penalty value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_location_base_total_spending > 0.00001 }
		sol_location_demand_consider_balanced_class = { class = 1 score = sol_location_demand_score_nobles }
		sol_location_demand_consider_balanced_class = { class = 2 score = sol_location_demand_score_clergy }
		sol_location_demand_consider_balanced_class = { class = 3 score = sol_location_demand_score_burghers }
		sol_location_demand_consider_balanced_class = { class = 4 score = sol_location_demand_score_lower }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_abs = {
	set_variable = { name = $target$ value = var:$source$ }
	if = { limit = { var:$target$ < 0 } change_variable = { name = $target$ multiply = -1 } }
}

sol_country_demand_eliminate_cell = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_cell_adjustment value = { value = var:sol_m_$pivot$_$col$ multiply = var:sol_demand_elimination_factor } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_m_$row$_$col$ subtract = var:sol_demand_cell_adjustment }
}

sol_country_demand_eliminate_rhs = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_rhs_adjustment value = { value = var:sol_b_$pivot$ multiply = var:sol_demand_elimination_factor } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_b_$row$ subtract = var:sol_demand_rhs_adjustment }
}

sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_demand_elimination_factor value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_$pivot$ divide = var:sol_m_$pivot$_$pivot$ } }
		sol_country_demand_eliminate_cell = { pivot = $pivot$ row = $row$ col = 1 }
		sol_country_demand_eliminate_cell = { pivot = $pivot$ row = $row$ col = 2 }
		sol_country_demand_eliminate_cell = { pivot = $pivot$ row = $row$ col = 3 }
		sol_country_demand_eliminate_cell = { pivot = $pivot$ row = $row$ col = 4 }
		sol_country_demand_eliminate_cell = { pivot = $pivot$ row = $row$ col = 5 }
		sol_country_demand_eliminate_rhs = { pivot = $pivot$ row = $row$ }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_check_pivot = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_m_$pivot$_$pivot$ target = sol_pivot_abs_$pivot$ }
		if = {
			# Class rows are normalized to nationwide stratum base, so this is a relative threshold.
			limit = { var:sol_pivot_abs_$pivot$ <= 0.0001 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -1 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_pivot value = $pivot$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_pivot_value value = var:sol_m_$pivot$_$pivot$ }
		}
	}
}

sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_rhs_adjustment value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_$col$ multiply = var:sol_delta_$col$ } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_delta_$row$ subtract = var:sol_demand_rhs_adjustment }
}

sol_country_demand_backsolve_row = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_$row$ value = var:sol_b_$row$ }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = { row = $row$ col = 5 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = { row = $row$ col = 4 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = { row = $row$ col = 3 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = { row = $row$ col = 2 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = { row = $row$ col = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_$row$ value = { value = var:sol_delta_$row$ divide = var:sol_m_$row$_$row$ } }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_rhs_adjustment value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_$col$ multiply = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_$col$ } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_$row$ subtract = var:sol_demand_rhs_adjustment }
}

sol_country_demand_backsolve_classes = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_4 value = { value = var:sol_b_4 divide = var:sol_m_4_4 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_3 value = var:sol_b_3 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 3 col = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_3 value = { value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_3 divide = var:sol_m_3_3 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_2 value = var:sol_b_2 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 2 col = 4 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 2 col = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_2 value = { value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_2 divide = var:sol_m_2_2 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_1 value = var:sol_b_1 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 1 col = 4 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 1 col = 3 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 1 col = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_1 value = { value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_1 divide = var:sol_m_1_1 } }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_select_anchor = {
	ordered_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			is_land = yes
			var:$score$ > 0.00001
			NOT = { has_variable = sol_demand_anchor_selected }
		}
		order_by = var:$score$
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = sol_demand_selected_anchor
		set_variable = { name = sol_demand_anchor_selected value = 1 }
		owner = {
			set_variable = { name = sol_demand_anchor_$anchor$ value = scope:sol_demand_selected_anchor }
			change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_anchor_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

sol_country_demand_fill_anchor_column = {
	var:sol_demand_anchor_$anchor$ = { save_scope_as = sol_demand_anchor_scope_$anchor$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_1_$col$ value = scope:sol_demand_anchor_scope_$anchor$.var:sol_location_nobles_base_spending }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_2_$col$ value = scope:sol_demand_anchor_scope_$anchor$.var:sol_location_clergy_base_spending }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_3_$col$ value = scope:sol_demand_anchor_scope_$anchor$.var:sol_location_burghers_base_spending }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_4_$col$ value = scope:sol_demand_anchor_scope_$anchor$.var:sol_location_commoners_base_spending }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_5_$col$ value = scope:sol_demand_anchor_scope_$anchor$.var:sol_location_tribesmen_base_spending }
}

sol_country_demand_clear_matrix = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_1_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_1_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_1_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_1_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_1_5 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_2_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_2_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_2_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_2_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_2_5 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_3_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_3_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_3_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_3_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_3_5 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_4_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_4_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_4_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_4_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_4_5 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_5_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_5_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_5_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_5_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_5_5 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_1 value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_nobles subtract = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_nobles } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_2 value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_clergy subtract = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_clergy } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_3 value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_burghers subtract = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_burghers } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_4 value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_commoners subtract = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_commoners } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_5 value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_tribesmen subtract = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_tribesmen } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_delta_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_delta_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_delta_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_delta_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_delta_5 value = 0 }
}

}

sol_country_demand_solve_4 = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solver_size value = 4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_mode value = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_clear_matrix = yes
	sol_country_demand_fill_anchor_column = { anchor = 1 col = 1 }
	sol_country_demand_fill_anchor_column = { anchor = 2 col = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_fill_anchor_column = { anchor = 3 col = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_fill_anchor_column = { anchor = 4 col = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_cache_original_matrix = yes
	sol_country_demand_check_pivot = { pivot = 1 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_pivot = { pivot = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 2 row = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 2 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_pivot = { pivot = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 3 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_pivot = { pivot = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_backsolve_row = { row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_backsolve_row = { row = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_backsolve_row = { row = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_backsolve_row = { row = 1 }
}

	sol_country_demand_backsolve_row = { row = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_backsolve_row = { row = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_backsolve_row = { row = 1 }
}

sol_country_demand_solve_classes = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solver_size value = 4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_mode value = 1 }
	sol_country_demand_clear_matrix = yes
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_target_lower value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_commoners add = var:sol_country_demand_target_tribesmen } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_baseline_lower value = { value = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_commoners add = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_tribesmen } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_nobles value = var:sol_country_demand_target_nobles }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_clergy value = var:sol_country_demand_target_clergy }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_burghers value = var:sol_country_demand_target_burghers }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_lower value = var:sol_country_demand_target_lower }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_1 value = var:sol_country_demand_rhs_nobles }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_2 value = var:sol_country_demand_rhs_clergy }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_3 value = var:sol_country_demand_rhs_burghers }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_4 value = var:sol_country_demand_rhs_lower }
	sol_country_demand_fill_class_matrix = yes
	sol_country_demand_measure_class_profile = { class = 1 signature = sol_country_class_score_nobles_1 cross_1 = sol_country_class_score_clergy_1 cross_2 = sol_country_class_score_burghers_1 cross_3 = sol_country_class_score_lower_1 }
	sol_country_demand_measure_class_profile = { class = 2 signature = sol_country_class_score_clergy_2 cross_1 = sol_country_class_score_nobles_2 cross_2 = sol_country_class_score_burghers_2 cross_3 = sol_country_class_score_lower_2 }
	sol_country_demand_measure_class_profile = { class = 3 signature = sol_country_class_score_burghers_3 cross_1 = sol_country_class_score_nobles_3 cross_2 = sol_country_class_score_clergy_3 cross_3 = sol_country_class_score_lower_3 }
	sol_country_demand_measure_class_profile = { class = 4 signature = sol_country_class_score_lower_4 cross_1 = sol_country_class_score_nobles_4 cross_2 = sol_country_class_score_clergy_4 cross_3 = sol_country_class_score_burghers_4 }
	# Row scaling is an exact preconditioner: it changes neither k nor the raw residual equation.
	sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_matrix = yes
	sol_country_demand_check_pivot = { pivot = 1 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_pivot = { pivot = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 2 row = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 2 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_pivot = { pivot = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 3 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_pivot = { pivot = 4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_4 value = 0 }
	sol_country_demand_backsolve_classes = yes
	sol_country_demand_validate_class = { class = 1 }
	sol_country_demand_validate_class = { class = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_validate_class = { class = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_validate_class = { class = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_compute_class_lhs = yes
	sol_country_demand_validate_class_residual = { row = 1 rhs = sol_country_demand_rhs_nobles }
	sol_country_demand_validate_class_residual = { row = 2 rhs = sol_country_demand_rhs_clergy }
	sol_country_demand_validate_class_residual = { row = 3 rhs = sol_country_demand_rhs_burghers }
	sol_country_demand_validate_class_residual = { row = 4 rhs = sol_country_demand_rhs_lower }
}

sol_country_demand_validate_anchor = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		var:sol_demand_anchor_$anchor$ = { save_scope_as = sol_demand_validation_anchor_$anchor$ }
		set_variable = { name = sol_candidate_scale_$anchor$ value = { value = scope:sol_demand_validation_anchor_$anchor$.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale add = var:sol_delta_$anchor$ } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sol_candidate_scale_$anchor$ < 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -2 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_anchor value = $anchor$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_anchor_scope value = scope:sol_demand_validation_anchor_$anchor$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_raw value = scope:sol_demand_validation_anchor_$anchor$.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_delta value = var:sol_delta_$anchor$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_candidate value = var:sol_candidate_scale_$anchor$ }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:sol_candidate_scale_$anchor$ > 20 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -3 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_anchor value = $anchor$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_anchor_scope value = scope:sol_demand_validation_anchor_$anchor$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_raw value = scope:sol_demand_validation_anchor_$anchor$.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_delta value = var:sol_delta_$anchor$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_candidate value = var:sol_candidate_scale_$anchor$ }
		}
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_delta_$anchor$ target = sol_delta_abs_$anchor$ }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_delta_abs_$anchor$ > var:sol_country_demand_max_adjustment } set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_max_adjustment value = var:sol_delta_abs_$anchor$ } }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_apply_anchor = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		var:sol_demand_anchor_$anchor$ = {
			set_variable = { name = sol_location_final_demand_scale value = { value = var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale add = owner.var:sol_delta_$anchor$ min = 0 } }
			set_variable = { name = sol_location_pop_demand_modifier_size value = { value = var:sol_location_final_demand_scale subtract = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

sol_country_demand_fill_class_column = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_1_$col$ value = var:sol_country_class_base_spending_nobles_$class$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_2_$col$ value = var:sol_country_class_base_spending_clergy_$class$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_3_$col$ value = var:sol_country_class_base_spending_burghers_$class$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_4_$col$ value = var:sol_country_class_base_lower_$class$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_5_$col$ value = var:sol_country_class_base_spending_tribesmen_$class$ }
}

sol_country_demand_fill_class_matrix = {
	sol_country_demand_fill_class_column = { class = 1 col = 1 }
	sol_country_demand_fill_class_column = { class = 2 col = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_fill_class_column = { class = 3 col = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_fill_class_column = { class = 4 col = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_cache_original_matrix = yes
	sol_country_demand_cache_normalized_class_matrix = yes
}

sol_country_demand_accumulate_score_diagnostics = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_base_total_spending > 0.00001 }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_classified_location_count add = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_total add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_confidence }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_confidence < var:sol_country_class_confidence_min } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_min value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_confidence } }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_confidence > var:sol_country_class_confidence_max } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_max value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_confidence } }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_base_total_spending > var:sol_country_class_max_location_base } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_location_base value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_base_total_spending } }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_nobles < var:sol_country_class_score_min_nobles } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_min_nobles value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_nobles } }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_nobles > var:sol_country_class_score_max_nobles } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_max_nobles value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_nobles } }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_clergy < var:sol_country_class_score_min_clergy } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_min_clergy value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_clergy } }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_clergy > var:sol_country_class_score_max_clergy } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_max_clergy value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_clergy } }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_burghers < var:sol_country_class_score_min_burghers } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_min_burghers value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_burghers } }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_burghers > var:sol_country_class_score_max_burghers } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_max_burghers value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_burghers } }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_lower < var:sol_country_class_score_min_lower } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_min_lower value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_lower } }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_lower > var:sol_country_class_score_max_lower } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_max_lower value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_score_lower } }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_structural_class = 1 } change_variable = { name = sol_country_structural_class_count_1 add = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_structural_class = 2 } change_variable = { name = sol_country_structural_class_count_2 add = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_structural_class = 3 } change_variable = { name = sol_country_structural_class_count_3 add = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_structural_class = 4 } change_variable = { name = sol_country_structural_class_count_4 add = 1 } }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_cache_normalized_class_row = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_normalized_m_$row$_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_normalized_m_$row$_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_normalized_m_$row$_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_normalized_m_$row$_4 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:$scale$ > 0.00001 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_normalized_m_$row$_1 value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_1 divide = var:$scale$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_normalized_m_$row$_2 value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_2 divide = var:$scale$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_normalized_m_$row$_3 value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_3 divide = var:$scale$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_normalized_m_$row$_4 value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_4 divide = var:$scale$ } }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_cache_normalized_class_matrix = {
	sol_country_demand_cache_normalized_class_row = { row = 1 scale = sol_country_base_spending_nobles }
	sol_country_demand_cache_normalized_class_row = { row = 2 scale = sol_country_base_spending_clergy }
	sol_country_demand_cache_normalized_class_row = { row = 3 scale = sol_country_base_spending_burghers }
	sol_country_demand_cache_normalized_class_row = { row = 4 scale = sol_country_base_spending_lower }
}

sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_row = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:$scale$ > 0.00001 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_m_$row$_1 value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_1 divide = var:$scale$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_m_$row$_2 value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_2 divide = var:$scale$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_m_$row$_3 value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_3 divide = var:$scale$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_m_$row$_4 value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_4 divide = var:$scale$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_b_$row$ value = { value = var:sol_b_$row$ divide = var:$scale$ } }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_matrix = {
	sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_row = { row = 1 scale = sol_country_base_spending_nobles }
	sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_row = { row = 2 scale = sol_country_base_spending_clergy }
	sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_row = { row = 3 scale = sol_country_base_spending_burghers }
	sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_row = { row = 4 scale = sol_country_base_spending_lower }
}

sol_country_demand_accumulate_class = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class = $class$
			scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_base_total_spending > 0.00001
		}
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_count_$class$ add = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_raw_total_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_total_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_base_total_spending }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_affinity_total_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_selected_affinity }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_penalty_total_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_selected_penalty }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_total_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_confidence }
		if = { limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_structural_class = $class$ } change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_structural_match_count_$class$ add = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_nobles_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_nobles_base_spending }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_clergy_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_clergy_base_spending }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_burghers_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_burghers_base_spending }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_commoners_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_commoners_base_spending }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_tribesmen_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_tribesmen_base_spending }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_lower_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_commoners_base_spending }
		change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_lower_$class$ add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_tribesmen_base_spending }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale < var:sol_country_class_min_raw_$class$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_min_raw_$class$ value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale > var:sol_country_class_max_raw_$class$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_raw_$class$ value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_selected_affinity < var:sol_country_class_min_affinity_$class$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_min_affinity_$class$ value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_selected_affinity }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_selected_affinity > var:sol_country_class_max_affinity_$class$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_affinity_$class$ value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_selected_affinity }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_example_$class$ value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_example_base_$class$ value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_base_total_spending }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_example_affinity_$class$ value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_selected_affinity }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_example_penalty_$class$ value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_selected_penalty }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_example_confidence_$class$ value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_class_confidence }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_example_structural_$class$ value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_demand_structural_class }
		}
	}
}

sol_country_demand_validate_class = {
	sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_country_class_coefficient_$class$ target = sol_country_class_coefficient_abs_$class$ }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_country_class_coefficient_abs_$class$ > var:sol_country_demand_max_adjustment } set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_max_adjustment value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_abs_$class$ } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sol_country_class_coefficient_$class$ < 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -2 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_class value = $class$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_class_coeff value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_$class$ }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:sol_country_class_coefficient_$class$ > 20 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -3 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_class value = $class$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_class_coeff value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_$class$ }
		}
	}
}

sol_country_demand_measure_class_profile = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_nobles_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_clergy_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_burghers_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_lower_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_signature_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_cross_score_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_signature_margin_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_share_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_deviation_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_affinity_avg_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_penalty_avg_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_avg_$class$ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_structural_match_rate_$class$ value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_country_base_spending_total > 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_share_$class$ value = { value = var:sol_country_class_base_total_$class$ divide = var:sol_country_base_spending_total } } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_country_class_target_base > 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_deviation_$class$ value = { value = var:sol_country_class_base_total_$class$ subtract = var:sol_country_class_target_base divide = var:sol_country_class_target_base } } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_class_count_$class$ > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_affinity_avg_$class$ value = { value = var:sol_country_class_affinity_total_$class$ divide = var:sol_country_class_count_$class$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_penalty_avg_$class$ value = { value = var:sol_country_class_penalty_total_$class$ divide = var:sol_country_class_count_$class$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_avg_$class$ value = { value = var:sol_country_class_confidence_total_$class$ divide = var:sol_country_class_count_$class$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_structural_match_rate_$class$ value = { value = var:sol_country_class_structural_match_count_$class$ divide = var:sol_country_class_count_$class$ } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_class_base_total_$class$ > 0.00001 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_nobles_$class$ value = { value = var:sol_country_class_base_spending_nobles_$class$ divide = var:sol_country_class_base_total_$class$ subtract = var:sol_country_share_nobles divide = var:sol_country_class_normalizer_nobles } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_clergy_$class$ value = { value = var:sol_country_class_base_spending_clergy_$class$ divide = var:sol_country_class_base_total_$class$ subtract = var:sol_country_share_clergy divide = var:sol_country_class_normalizer_clergy } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_burghers_$class$ value = { value = var:sol_country_class_base_spending_burghers_$class$ divide = var:sol_country_class_base_total_$class$ subtract = var:sol_country_share_burghers divide = var:sol_country_class_normalizer_burghers } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_lower_$class$ value = { value = var:sol_country_class_base_lower_$class$ divide = var:sol_country_class_base_total_$class$ subtract = var:sol_country_share_lower divide = var:sol_country_class_normalizer_lower } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_signature_$class$ value = var:$signature$ }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_cross_score_$class$ value = var:$cross_1$ }
		if = { limit = { var:$cross_2$ > var:sol_country_class_cross_score_$class$ } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_cross_score_$class$ value = var:$cross_2$ } }
		if = { limit = { var:$cross_3$ > var:sol_country_class_cross_score_$class$ } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_cross_score_$class$ value = var:$cross_3$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_signature_margin_$class$ value = { value = var:sol_country_class_signature_$class$ subtract = var:sol_country_class_cross_score_$class$ } }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_validate_class_residual = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_residual_$row$ value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_lhs_$row$ subtract = var:$rhs$ } }
	sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_country_class_residual_$row$ target = sol_country_class_residual_abs_$row$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_residual_tolerance_$row$ value = { value = var:$rhs$ multiply = 0.001 add = 0.01 } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 var:sol_country_class_residual_abs_$row$ > var:sol_country_class_residual_tolerance_$row$ }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -7 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_row value = $row$ }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_residual value = var:sol_country_class_residual_$row$ }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_tolerance value = var:sol_country_class_residual_tolerance_$row$ }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_apply_class = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_location_demand_class = $class$ }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_final_demand_scale value = owner.var:sol_country_class_coefficient_$class$ }
		set_variable = { name = sol_location_pop_demand_modifier_size value = { value = var:sol_location_final_demand_scale subtract = 1 } }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_finalize_diagnostics = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_nobles value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_clergy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_burghers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_commoners value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_tribesmen value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_lower value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes }
			save_scope_as = sol_demand_diagnostic_location
			owner = {
				set_variable = { name = sol_demand_scaled_tmp value = { value = scope:sol_demand_diagnostic_location.var:sol_location_nobles_base_spending multiply = scope:sol_demand_diagnostic_location.var:sol_location_final_demand_scale } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_nobles add = var:sol_demand_scaled_tmp }
				set_variable = { name = sol_demand_scaled_tmp value = { value = scope:sol_demand_diagnostic_location.var:sol_location_clergy_base_spending multiply = scope:sol_demand_diagnostic_location.var:sol_location_final_demand_scale } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_clergy add = var:sol_demand_scaled_tmp }
				set_variable = { name = sol_demand_scaled_tmp value = { value = scope:sol_demand_diagnostic_location.var:sol_location_burghers_base_spending multiply = scope:sol_demand_diagnostic_location.var:sol_location_final_demand_scale } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_burghers add = var:sol_demand_scaled_tmp }
				set_variable = { name = sol_demand_scaled_tmp value = { value = scope:sol_demand_diagnostic_location.var:sol_location_commoners_base_spending multiply = scope:sol_demand_diagnostic_location.var:sol_location_final_demand_scale } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_commoners add = var:sol_demand_scaled_tmp }
				set_variable = { name = sol_demand_scaled_tmp value = { value = scope:sol_demand_diagnostic_location.var:sol_location_tribesmen_base_spending multiply = scope:sol_demand_diagnostic_location.var:sol_location_final_demand_scale } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_tribesmen add = var:sol_demand_scaled_tmp }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_solved_spending_lower value = { value = var:sol_country_solved_spending_commoners add = var:sol_country_solved_spending_tribesmen } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_error_nobles value = { value = var:sol_country_solved_spending_nobles subtract = var:sol_country_demand_target_nobles } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_error_clergy value = { value = var:sol_country_solved_spending_clergy subtract = var:sol_country_demand_target_clergy } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_error_burghers value = { value = var:sol_country_solved_spending_burghers subtract = var:sol_country_demand_target_burghers } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_error_commoners value = { value = var:sol_country_solved_spending_commoners subtract = var:sol_country_demand_target_commoners } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_error_tribesmen value = { value = var:sol_country_solved_spending_tribesmen subtract = var:sol_country_demand_target_tribesmen } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_target_lower value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_commoners add = var:sol_country_demand_target_tribesmen } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_baseline_lower value = { value = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_commoners add = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_tribesmen } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_error_lower value = { value = var:sol_country_solved_spending_lower subtract = var:sol_country_demand_target_lower } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_mode = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_nobles value = var:sol_country_demand_target_nobles }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_clergy value = var:sol_country_demand_target_clergy }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_burghers value = var:sol_country_demand_target_burghers }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_commoners value = var:sol_country_demand_target_commoners }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_tribesmen value = var:sol_country_demand_target_tribesmen }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_lower value = var:sol_country_demand_target_lower }
		sol_country_demand_compute_class_lhs = yes
		sol_country_demand_validate_class_residual = { row = 1 rhs = sol_country_demand_rhs_nobles }
		sol_country_demand_validate_class_residual = { row = 2 rhs = sol_country_demand_rhs_clergy }
		sol_country_demand_validate_class_residual = { row = 3 rhs = sol_country_demand_rhs_burghers }
		sol_country_demand_validate_class_residual = { row = 4 rhs = sol_country_demand_rhs_lower }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_nobles value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_nobles subtract = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_nobles } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_clergy value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_clergy subtract = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_clergy } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_burghers value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_burghers subtract = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_burghers } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_commoners value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_commoners subtract = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_commoners } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_tribesmen value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_tribesmen subtract = var:sol_country_baseline_spending_tribesmen } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_lower value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_target_lower subtract = var:sol_country_baseline_lower } }
		sol_country_demand_compute_row_lhs = { row = 1 }
		sol_country_demand_compute_row_lhs = { row = 2 }
		sol_country_demand_compute_row_lhs = { row = 3 }
		sol_country_demand_compute_row_lhs = { row = 4 }
		sol_country_demand_compute_row_lhs = { row = 5 }
	}
}

	}
}

	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_eq_tmp value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_2 multiply = var:sol_delta_2 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_lhs_$row$ add = var:sol_demand_eq_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_eq_tmp value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_3 multiply = var:sol_delta_3 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_lhs_$row$ add = var:sol_demand_eq_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_eq_tmp value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_4 multiply = var:sol_delta_4 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_lhs_$row$ add = var:sol_demand_eq_tmp }
	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_eq_tmp value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_5 multiply = var:sol_delta_5 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_lhs_$row$ add = var:sol_demand_eq_tmp }
}

sol_country_demand_cmf_log = {
	save_scope_as = _cmf_log_actor

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = cmf_log_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = cmf_log_count value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			is_human = yes
			global_var:cmf_log_count < 200
		}
		_cmf_log_select_key = yes
		sol_country_demand_log_clear_entry = yes
		sol_country_demand_log_store_common = yes
		sol_country_demand_log_store_anchor = { anchor = 1 }
		sol_country_demand_log_store_anchor = { anchor = 2 }
		sol_country_demand_log_store_anchor = { anchor = 3 }
		sol_country_demand_log_store_anchor = { anchor = 4 }
		sol_country_demand_log_store_anchor = { anchor = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_mode = 1 }
			sol_country_demand_log_store_class = { class = 1 }
			sol_country_demand_log_store_class = { class = 2 }
			sol_country_demand_log_store_class = { class = 3 }
			sol_country_demand_log_store_class = { class = 4 }
		}
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = cmf_log_action key = scope:_cmf_log_key }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = cmf_log_action key = scope:_cmf_log_key value = flag:$action$ }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = cmf_log_actor key = scope:_cmf_log_key }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = cmf_log_actor key = scope:_cmf_log_key value = scope:_cmf_log_actor }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = cmf_log_arg_mode key = scope:_cmf_log_key }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = cmf_log_arg_mode key = scope:_cmf_log_key value = 0 }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = cmf_log_arg1 key = scope:_cmf_log_key }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = cmf_log_arg1 key = scope:_cmf_log_key value = flag:_cmf_log_no_arg }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = cmf_log_arg2 key = scope:_cmf_log_key }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = cmf_log_arg2 key = scope:_cmf_log_key value = flag:$detail$ }
		change_global_variable = { name = cmf_log_count add = 1 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { always = no }
		cmf_suppress = { v = $action$ }
		cmf_suppress = { v = $detail$ }
	}
}
