	sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_TARGET_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_TARGET_LOWER }
}

sol_country_demand_log_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes }
		sol_country_demand_prepare_log_anchor = { anchor = 1 }
		sol_country_demand_prepare_log_anchor = { anchor = 2 }
		sol_country_demand_prepare_log_anchor = { anchor = 3 }
		sol_country_demand_prepare_log_anchor = { anchor = 4 }
		sol_country_demand_prepare_log_anchor = { anchor = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_mode = 1 }
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_REFRESH_SUCCESS_CLASS detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY_CLASS }
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_CLASS_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_CLASS_COUNTRY }
				sol_country_demand_log_class_rows = yes
				sol_country_demand_log_rhs_rows = yes
				sol_country_demand_log_class_equation_rows = yes
				sol_country_demand_log_class_normalized_equation_rows = yes
				sol_country_demand_log_final_error_rows = yes
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solver_size >= 5 }
					sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_REFRESH_SUCCESS_5 detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
				}
				else = {
					sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_REFRESH_SUCCESS_4 detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
				}
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY }
				sol_country_demand_log_anchor_rows = yes
				sol_country_demand_log_error_rows = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_mode = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -1 }
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_SINGULAR detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -2 }
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_NEGATIVE_CLASS detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -3 }
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_TOO_HIGH_CLASS detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -4 }
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_CLASS_MISSING detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -5 }
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_NO_BASE detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			else = {
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_CLASS_RESIDUAL detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY_CLASS }
			sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_CLASS_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_CLASS_COUNTRY }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -1 } sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_PIVOT_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_PIVOT } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -4 } sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_CLASS_FAILURE_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_CLASS_MISSING } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -7 } sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_CLASS_FAILURE_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_CLASS_RESIDUAL } }
			else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -2 var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -3 } } sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_CLASS_FAILURE_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_CLASS_FAILURE } }
			sol_country_demand_log_class_rows = yes
			sol_country_demand_log_rhs_rows = yes
			sol_country_demand_log_class_equation_rows = yes
			sol_country_demand_log_class_normalized_equation_rows = yes
			sol_country_demand_log_final_error_rows = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solver_size >= 5 }
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_SINGULAR detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			else = {
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_SINGULAR detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY }
			sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_PIVOT_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_PIVOT }
			sol_country_demand_log_anchor_rows = yes
			sol_country_demand_log_error_rows = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -2 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solver_size >= 5 }
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_NEGATIVE detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			else = {
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_NEGATIVE detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY }
			sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_FAILURE_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_FAILURE_SCALE }
			sol_country_demand_log_anchor_rows = yes
			sol_country_demand_log_error_rows = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -3 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solver_size >= 5 }
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_TOO_HIGH detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			else = {
				sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_TOO_HIGH detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			}
			sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_SUMMARY }
			sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_FAILURE_ACTION detail = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_DETAIL_FAILURE_SCALE }
			sol_country_demand_log_anchor_rows = yes
			sol_country_demand_log_error_rows = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -4 }
			sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_ANCHORS detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			sol_country_demand_log_count_rows = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = -5 }
			sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_NO_BASE detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			sol_country_demand_log_count_rows = yes
		}
		else = {
			sol_country_demand_cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_FALLBACK_NO_LOCATIONS detail = _cmf_log_no_arg }
			sol_country_demand_log_count_rows = yes
		}
	}
}

	set_variable = { name = sol_country_classified_location_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_total value = 0 }

	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_min_clergy value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_max_clergy value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_min_burghers value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_max_burghers value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_min_lower value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_max_lower value = -999999 }

	set_variable = { name = sol_country_structural_class_count_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_structural_class_count_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_structural_class_count_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_pivot_abs_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_pivot_abs_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_pivot_abs_3 value = 0 }

	set_variable = { name = sol_country_baseline_spending_commoners value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_baseline_spending_tribesmen value = 0 }
	sol_country_demand_clear_matrix = yes
	sol_country_demand_cache_original_matrix = yes
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_nobles value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_rhs_clergy value = 0 }

	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_total_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_total_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_total_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_total_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_raw_total_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_raw_total_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_raw_total_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_raw_total_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_affinity_total_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_affinity_total_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_affinity_total_3 value = 0 }

	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_penalty_total_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_penalty_total_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_penalty_total_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_penalty_total_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_total_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_total_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_total_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_total_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_structural_match_count_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_structural_match_count_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_structural_match_count_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_structural_match_count_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_nobles_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_nobles_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_nobles_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_nobles_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_clergy_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_clergy_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_clergy_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_clergy_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_burghers_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_burghers_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_burghers_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_burghers_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_commoners_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_commoners_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_commoners_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_commoners_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_tribesmen_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_tribesmen_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_tribesmen_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_spending_tribesmen_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_lower_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_lower_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_lower_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_base_lower_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_min_raw_1 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_min_raw_2 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_min_raw_3 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_min_raw_4 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_raw_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_raw_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_raw_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_raw_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_min_affinity_1 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_min_affinity_2 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_min_affinity_3 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_min_affinity_4 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_affinity_1 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_affinity_2 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_affinity_3 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_affinity_4 value = -999999 }
	remove_variable = sol_country_class_example_1
	remove_variable = sol_country_class_example_2
	remove_variable = sol_country_class_example_3
	remove_variable = sol_country_class_example_4
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes }
		cmf_log = { action = CMF_LOG_SOL_DEMAND_REFRESH_START }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes }
			remove_variable = sol_demand_anchor_selected
			sol_compute_location_pop_demand = yes
			save_scope_as = sol_demand_cached_location
			owner = {
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_target_nobles add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_nobles_liquid_funds }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_target_clergy add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_clergy_liquid_funds }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_target_burghers add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_burghers_liquid_funds }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_target_commoners add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_commoners_liquid_funds }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_target_tribesmen add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_tribesmen_liquid_funds }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_base_spending_nobles add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_nobles_base_spending }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_base_spending_clergy add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_clergy_base_spending }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_base_spending_burghers add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_burghers_base_spending }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_base_spending_commoners add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_commoners_base_spending }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_base_spending_tribesmen add = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_tribesmen_base_spending }
				set_variable = { name = sol_demand_scaled_tmp value = { value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_nobles_base_spending multiply = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_baseline_spending_nobles add = var:sol_demand_scaled_tmp }
				set_variable = { name = sol_demand_scaled_tmp value = { value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_clergy_base_spending multiply = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_baseline_spending_clergy add = var:sol_demand_scaled_tmp }
				set_variable = { name = sol_demand_scaled_tmp value = { value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_burghers_base_spending multiply = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_baseline_spending_burghers add = var:sol_demand_scaled_tmp }
				set_variable = { name = sol_demand_scaled_tmp value = { value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_commoners_base_spending multiply = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_baseline_spending_commoners add = var:sol_demand_scaled_tmp }
				set_variable = { name = sol_demand_scaled_tmp value = { value = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_tribesmen_base_spending multiply = scope:sol_demand_cached_location.var:sol_location_raw_demand_scale } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_country_baseline_spending_tribesmen add = var:sol_demand_scaled_tmp }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_base_spending_lower value = { value = var:sol_country_base_spending_commoners add = var:sol_country_base_spending_tribesmen } }
	set_variable = {
		name = sol_country_base_spending_total
		value = {
			add = var:sol_country_base_spending_nobles
			add = var:sol_country_base_spending_clergy
			add = var:sol_country_base_spending_burghers
			add = var:sol_country_base_spending_lower
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_base_spending_total > 0.00001 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_share_nobles value = { value = var:sol_country_base_spending_nobles divide = var:sol_country_base_spending_total min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_share_clergy value = { value = var:sol_country_base_spending_clergy divide = var:sol_country_base_spending_total min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_share_burghers value = { value = var:sol_country_base_spending_burghers divide = var:sol_country_base_spending_total min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_share_lower value = { value = var:sol_country_base_spending_lower divide = var:sol_country_base_spending_total min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_target_base value = { value = var:sol_country_base_spending_total divide = 4 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_normalizer_nobles value = var:sol_country_share_nobles }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_normalizer_clergy value = var:sol_country_share_clergy }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_normalizer_burghers value = var:sol_country_share_burghers }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_normalizer_lower value = var:sol_country_share_lower }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_country_class_normalizer_nobles < 0.02 } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_normalizer_nobles value = 0.02 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_country_class_normalizer_clergy < 0.02 } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_normalizer_clergy value = 0.02 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_country_class_normalizer_burghers < 0.02 } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_normalizer_burghers value = 0.02 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_country_class_normalizer_lower < 0.02 } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_normalizer_lower value = 0.02 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 var:sol_country_base_spending_total > 0.00001 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes }
			sol_location_prepare_demand_class_scores = yes
			save_scope_as = sol_demand_cached_location
			owner = { sol_country_demand_accumulate_score_diagnostics = yes }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:sol_country_classified_location_count > 0 } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_avg value = { value = var:sol_country_class_confidence_total divide = var:sol_country_classified_location_count } } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_country_class_target_base > 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_max_location_target_ratio value = { value = var:sol_country_class_max_location_base divide = var:sol_country_class_target_base } } }
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes var:sol_location_base_total_spending > 0.00001 }
			order_by = var:sol_location_demand_class_confidence
			# ordered_* defaults to a single result; an explicit high max is required for the full pass.
			max = 100000
			check_range_bounds = no
			sol_location_assign_demand_class = yes
			save_scope_as = sol_demand_cached_location
			owner = {
				sol_country_demand_accumulate_class = { class = 1 }
				sol_country_demand_accumulate_class = { class = 2 }
				sol_country_demand_accumulate_class = { class = 3 }
				sol_country_demand_accumulate_class = { class = 4 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_classified_location_count <= 0 }
		# Keep no-base diagnostics explicit instead of leaking initialization sentinels.
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_min value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_confidence_max value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_min_nobles value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_max_nobles value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_min_clergy value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_max_clergy value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_min_burghers value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_max_burghers value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_min_lower value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_score_max_lower value = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_anchor_count value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_country_class_count_1 > 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_anchor_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_country_class_count_2 > 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_anchor_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_country_class_count_3 > 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_anchor_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_country_class_count_4 > 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_anchor_count add = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_base_spending_total > 0.00001 }
		sol_country_demand_clear_matrix = yes
		sol_country_demand_fill_class_matrix = yes
		# Cache normalized structure and relative signatures even if a class is missing.
		sol_country_demand_measure_class_profile = { class = 1 signature = sol_country_class_score_nobles_1 cross_1 = sol_country_class_score_clergy_1 cross_2 = sol_country_class_score_burghers_1 cross_3 = sol_country_class_score_lower_1 }
		sol_country_demand_measure_class_profile = { class = 2 signature = sol_country_class_score_clergy_2 cross_1 = sol_country_class_score_nobles_2 cross_2 = sol_country_class_score_burghers_2 cross_3 = sol_country_class_score_lower_2 }
		sol_country_demand_measure_class_profile = { class = 3 signature = sol_country_class_score_burghers_3 cross_1 = sol_country_class_score_nobles_3 cross_2 = sol_country_class_score_clergy_3 cross_3 = sol_country_class_score_lower_3 }
		sol_country_demand_measure_class_profile = { class = 4 signature = sol_country_class_score_lower_4 cross_1 = sol_country_class_score_nobles_4 cross_2 = sol_country_class_score_clergy_4 cross_3 = sol_country_class_score_burghers_4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 var:sol_country_base_spending_total <= 0.00001 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solver_size value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_mode value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			num_locations > 0
			var:sol_country_base_spending_total > 0.00001
			OR = {
				var:sol_country_class_count_1 <= 0
				var:sol_country_class_count_2 <= 0
				var:sol_country_class_count_3 <= 0
				var:sol_country_class_count_4 <= 0
				var:sol_country_class_base_total_1 <= 0.00001
				var:sol_country_class_base_total_2 <= 0.00001
				var:sol_country_class_base_total_3 <= 0.00001
				var:sol_country_class_base_total_4 <= 0.00001
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solver_size value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_mode value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -4 }
		if = { limit = { OR = { var:sol_country_class_count_1 <= 0 var:sol_country_class_base_total_1 <= 0.00001 } } set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_class value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:sol_country_class_count_2 <= 0 var:sol_country_class_base_total_2 <= 0.00001 } } set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_class value = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:sol_country_class_count_3 <= 0 var:sol_country_class_base_total_3 <= 0.00001 } } set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_class value = 3 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_failure_class value = 4 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 var:sol_country_base_spending_total > 0.00001 }
		sol_country_demand_solve_classes = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 num_locations > 0 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes }
			sol_country_demand_apply_class = { class = 1 }
			sol_country_demand_apply_class = { class = 2 }
			sol_country_demand_apply_class = { class = 3 }
			sol_country_demand_apply_class = { class = 4 }
		}
	}
	sol_country_demand_finalize_diagnostics = yes
	sol_country_demand_log_refresh = yes
}

sol_update_local_pop_demand_modifiers = {
	# root = country. Monthly pulse solves final country-stratum demand scales, then applies them by location.
	sol_solve_country_pop_demand = yes
	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes }
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = sol_local_pop_demand_modifier
				months = 1
				mode = replace
				size = var:sol_location_pop_demand_modifier_size
			}
		}
	}
}

gls_update_location_map = {
	# root = country. Rebuild display caches without waiting for pulse order.
	sol_solve_country_pop_demand = yes
}

gls_compute_panel_display = {
	# root = country. Kept as the situation GUI entry point.
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sol_country_demand_solve_status } } sol_solve_country_pop_demand = yes }
	else = { gls_compute_savings_pressure = yes }
}

gls_accumulate_panel_stats = {
	# root = country. Reads the final location demand cache for country GUI diagnostics.
	set_variable = { name = gls_location_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gls_location_scale_sum value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gls_country_wealth value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gls_control_sum value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gls_pop_nobles value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gls_pop_clergy value = 0 }

	if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(gls_country_consumes_weaponry|scope:gls_panel_country)" > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = gls_country_consumed_goods_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(gls_country_consumes_wheat|scope:gls_panel_country)" > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = gls_country_consumed_goods_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(gls_country_consumes_wild_game|scope:gls_panel_country)" > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = gls_country_consumed_goods_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(gls_country_consumes_wine|scope:gls_panel_country)" > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = gls_country_consumed_goods_count add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:gls_country_consumed_goods_count >= 0 } change_local_variable = { name = gls_country_consumed_goods_count add = 0 } }
	remove_local_variable = gls_country_consumed_goods_count

	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes }
			sol_compute_location_pop_demand = yes
			save_scope_as = gls_cached_location
			owner = {
				change_variable = { name = gls_location_count add = 1 }
				change_variable = { name = gls_location_scale_sum add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_pop_demand_scale }
				change_variable = { name = gls_country_wealth add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_wealth_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_control_sum add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_control }
				change_variable = { name = gls_pop_nobles add = scope:gls_cached_location.num_pop_type:nobles }
				change_variable = { name = gls_pop_clergy add = scope:gls_cached_location.num_pop_type:clergy }
				change_variable = { name = gls_pop_burghers add = scope:gls_cached_location.num_pop_type:burghers }
				change_variable = { name = gls_pop_commoners add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_commoner_population }
				change_variable = { name = gls_pop_tribesmen add = scope:gls_cached_location.num_pop_type:tribesmen }
				change_variable = { name = gls_pop_all add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_population_sum }
				change_variable = { name = gls_income_nobles add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_nobles_income_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_income_clergy add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_clergy_income_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_income_burghers add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_burghers_income_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_income_commoners add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_commoners_income_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_income_tribesmen add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_tribesmen_income_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_total_income add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_total_income }
				change_variable = { name = gls_building_maintenance_nobles add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_nobles_building_maintenance }
				change_variable = { name = gls_building_maintenance_clergy add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_clergy_building_maintenance }
				change_variable = { name = gls_building_maintenance_burghers add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_burghers_building_maintenance }
				change_variable = { name = gls_building_maintenance_commoners add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_commoners_building_maintenance }
				change_variable = { name = gls_building_maintenance_tribesmen add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_tribesmen_building_maintenance }
				change_variable = { name = gls_country_base_spending add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_base_spending_display }
				change_variable = { name = gls_country_liquid_funds add = scope:gls_cached_location.local_sol_liquid_funds_display }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { var:gls_location_count > 0 } set_variable = { name = gls_country_location_avg_scale value = { add = var:gls_location_scale_sum divide = var:gls_location_count } } }
	if = { limit = { var:gls_location_count > 0 } set_variable = { name = gls_country_final_demand_scale_avg value = var:gls_country_location_avg_scale } }
	if = { limit = { var:gls_country_base_spending > 0 } set_variable = { name = gls_country_sol_all value = { value = var:gls_country_liquid_funds divide = var:gls_country_base_spending min = 0 } } }
}

gls_full_refresh_country = {
	# root = country. sol_update_local_pop_demand_modifiers already refreshes
	# gls_savings_pressure_adjustment, so gls_compute_panel_display would be redundant here.
	sol_update_estate_building_maintenance = yes
	set_variable = { name = sol_estate_building_maintenance_initialized value = 1 }
	sol_update_local_pop_demand_modifiers = yes
	gls_accumulate_panel_stats = yes
}

gls_recalculate_global_living_standard = {
	# World scope: refresh market maps once, then refresh all countries.
	sol_refresh_market_pop_demand_maps = yes
	every_country = { if = { limit = { total_population > 0 } gls_full_refresh_country = yes } }
}
